description: A bearded man in a black robe and dark wrapped turban leans into a long wooden lever on a screw printing press in a dim workshop. A glowing oil lamp sits on the right, and ink pots and stacked paper lie on a table at left. Sheets of paper hang on cords across the top, covered in rows of small dark marks that look like script. The painting is a warm, dark oil style and fills the whole image edge to edge.
reason: The hanging sheets are covered in dense rows of Arabic-like script. The scene asked for sheets with no legible script, and the script-like marks could read as painted-in text. Regenerate or paint the sheets blank or as abstract texture.
